evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected complete native bodies and operand-bound layout. Shared/custom effect readers reuse typed registry objects by ID, retain references and conditionally append actual pointers into the bank usage-slot object array. Bank reference release decrements each stored object. Zero-reference final release removes the object from its typed registry, calls the virtual destroy route, terminates template parameters and frees object storage. Game-sync registration inserts the actual subscriber pointer into an entry/key-selected target array; removal removes the matching pointer. State/property registration is a separate route.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Layouts for bank key and callback target lists require the selected calling route. Private original execution supplies owned registries, arrays and allocators, never initializes the audio engine.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual live bank occurrence, successful nonempty engine subscriptions, concurrent cross-thread object generations and live final destruction require capture. Equal settings do not identify live bank ownership.

parameterProjection.selection: Only normal registered Room return with stable parameter pointer/vtable and identical known setting bytes at entry and return.

recordFields.parameterId: u16 at record start, zero extended into virtual setter

initialApplication.behavior: Initial Subscribe calls this routine after registration. It composes the provided default through current property aggregates and calls the retained clone virtual setter with four bytes. Setter status is ignored by this outer application; outer success is not a subscription or accepted-write witness.
initialApplication.observationalLimit: Later asynchronous callbacks are a separate path and require actual target/state membership plus an observed accepted setter.

key.matching: ID and type together; an equal low-word ID is insufficient

modes.formula: product of retained per-source contributions after matching contribution replacement or append
max(0, retained per-source contributions after matching contribution replacement or append)

conditions: owned property storage or successful native growth

notificationApplication.cacheBehavior: Two previous input/mapped-value pairs avoid curve reevaluation; missing curve storage maps an uncached input to zero.
notificationApplication.contributionIdentity: parameter ID plus notification source kind and curve ID
notificationApplication.setterBehavior: Uses four-byte mapped aggregate through retained parameter virtual setter; outer notification ignores setter status.
notificationApplication.evidenceLimit: Owned original cached and uncached linear/no-scaling examples prove conditional transport into Room processing. Live definitions, engine scheduling, non-linear curve/scaling branches and unique physical bank occurrence remain separate.

framing: point count times {f32 from, f32 to, u32 interpolation}
definitionLoad.parameterIdDomain: selected effect plug-in virtual setter, not the node property-ID domain
definitionLoad.carrierBehavior: Subscribe copies template definition keys and descriptor pointers into its own list and registers the real subscriber interface. Attaching a new definition also walks existing template carriers, copies the descriptor and subscribes each carrier.
definitionLoad.cleanupBehavior: Carrier release clears definition count and parameter retention. Subscriber destructor additionally frees the retained definition-list allocation and destroys the nested subscription interface.
definitionLoad.providedOriginalExample: Serialized Room definition with nonempty linear/no-scaling curve and two points; original loading/copying/automatic target insertion/accepted setter, final subscriber and template destruction complete with no outstanding owned allocations.
definitionLoad.unresolved: Authored game occurrence, live scheduling and physical package identity
